title: inula crithmoides subsp. longifolia
intro: Inula crithmoides subsp. longifolia, commonly known as Sea Inula, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) characterized by its tall, erect stems and yellow flowers. The health benefits of Sea Inula include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as wounds, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Sea Inula include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents found in Sea Inula include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
